description: Council-attested policy governing how the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) commits its distributable surplus to donate to the non-profit religious-corp, per ADR-2605301036 §6 (Mission-Funding Earned-Revenue Arm). The vendor exists to FUND the mission, not to accumulate — this record pins the payout ratio + operating reserve so the surplus-commitment is on-chain and auditable. It governs ONLY the vendor→religious-corp donation flow (purpose ∈ {donation,grant}, titheable per ADR-2605192130); it NEVER authorizes cash to adherents (cashStipendUsdMicros≡0 stays invariant per ADR-2605261000 §5 N1 / ADR-2605301020). Because Payoff帰属・意思決定権 = etzhayyim only, the vendor has no private equity holder to enrich. All quantities are integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900.

policyVersion.description: Monotonic policy version id, e.g. v1. A new policy supersedes the prior; both remain on-record for audit.

vendorDid.description: DID of the commercial vendor entity (etzhayyim.com) this policy binds.

effectiveFrom.description: ISO 8601 start of the policy's effective window.

effectiveTo.description: Optional ISO 8601 end of the effective window; absent = open-ended until superseded.

payoutRatioBps.description: Fraction of the vendor's distributable surplus committed to donation, basis points (×10000; 10000 = 100%). Council sets the value; the mission-funding intent (ADR-2605301036 §6) is a high ratio — the vendor accumulates only the operating reserve below.

operatingReserveMonths.description: Months of vendor operating cost retained before the payout applies (continuity reserve). The remainder is the distributable surplus the payout ratio acts on.

recipientDefault.description: Default earmark for the donated surplus' 90% recipient leg (the 10% tithe always reaches the Public Fund). public-fund routes ~100% to the mission.

councilAttestation.description: Council Lv6+ ≥3 DIDs attesting this policy (ADR-2605301036 §6 + ADR-2605192300).

attestationCid.description: CID of the full attestation payload / deliberation record.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the policy record.
